primary_user_journeys.name: Text-to-Vector Generative Synthesis
primary_user_journeys.description: User enters text prompt, style preset, complexity tier, and palette; backend model orchestrator queries Gemini model pool and returns layered semantic SVG DOM conforming to VECTORA contracts.

primary_user_journeys.name: Multimodal Raster & Brief Vectorization
primary_user_journeys.description: User uploads an image, document, or pastes raw text/SVG; algorithmic tracer (17 client-side algorithms) or server vision model vectorizes the content into an editable multi-layer SVG document.

primary_user_journeys.name: Interactive Artboard & Layer Tree Editing
primary_user_journeys.description: User navigates the SVG canvas (pan/zoom, coordinate crosshairs, grids), modifies AST layers (visibility, lock, solo, rename, reorder, blend modes), and alters document state via undoable commands.

primary_user_journeys.name: Real-time Refinement & Parametric Motion Animation
primary_user_journeys.description: User refines artwork with natural language directives, adjusts parametric FX (stroke scale, grain, glow, palette remapping, plugins), or choreographs CSS/SMIL animations via the motion timeline.

primary_user_journeys.name: Multi-Format Production Export & GitHub Versioning
primary_user_journeys.description: User exports the canonical artwork to .SVG, high-resolution .PNG (1x-8x), React TSX components, CSS Data URI, animated GIFs/sprites, or commits directly to a remote GitHub repository via OAuth session.

in_scope: AI vector generation and conversational refinement
Multimodal raster-to-SVG vectorization (17 client-side algorithms + AI vision)
Interactive vector canvas (Cartesian/Polar/Isometric drafting grids, pan/zoom)
AST-backed layer management (Inkscape layer groups, visibility, locks, renaming, blend modes)
Undo/redo command history and persistence (IndexedDB autosave + localStorage)
Parametric filter controls and functional plugin ecosystem
CSS/SMIL kinetic animation studio, timeline scrubber, and GIF/spritesheet export
Multi-format code/file export (.SVG, .PNG, React TSX, CSS Data URI)
Hardened server-side GitHub OAuth connection and design syncing
out_of_scope: Full 3D spatial mesh rendering (Three.js/WebGL scene pipelines)
Server-side relational SQL database (Cloud SQL / PostgreSQL) - uses client-side IndexedDB and server-side sessions
Payment gateway and commercial subscription billing
